mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, reducing corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If forward returns remain positive despite high rates, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing industrial production signals supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
